_code_delta: ⚠ BUILT AFTER THE 2026-10-02 PLAYTEST FIXES (user, 22:15: 'Fix and go with n=3'), so the BOOK is the 2+1's byte for byte but the BUILD is not: (1) tools/emit_secondaries.mjs no longer keeps a vanilla-gated secondary on a building that can never run it — Elastics on the Handsewn Clothes craft and on Dye Workshops, Precision Tools on the Handcrafted Furniture craft, Bone China on the Forest Glass craft and on Leaded Glass were SHOWN (greyed, at vanilla numbers, −70 clothes / −55 furniture / −20 glass against a craft level's 2–3) though no country could select them: no economic effect, a display defect; (2) NARRATIVE COMPATIBILITY, REVIEWED PAIR BY PAIR (BALANCE_FRAMEWORK §10.93; user, 23:15: 'No, no universal rule. Go through all vanilla combinations one by one'; accepted 23:45): tools/lib_secondary_compat.mjs, 139 pairs reviewed, 14 incompatible — on this book it removes Assembly Lines from the Muskets (e0), Rifles (e1), Cannons (e0), Smoothbores (e1), Percussion Caps (e1) and Wrought Iron Tools (e1) buildings (the other eight incompatible pairs sit on the six e0 methods that are crafts here, whose automation the craft ruling already removes); PLUS (user, 23:55) THE AUTOMATION THAT IS NARRATIVELY THE SAME AS A MAIN METHOD is MANDATED on that main method and removed from the rungs below it: Mechanized Looms always on beside Sewing Machines, Automatic Power Looms always on beside Electric Sewing Machines (the merged textile building's automation group holds only those two, each gated to its own method), Assembly Lines always on beside Mass Production; Dye Workshops (e1 textile) and Automobile Production (e2) lose their automation entirely. A REAL but small economic change (automation on old rungs; the three mandated rungs pay vanilla's automation goods always and need fewer laborers); (3) tools/build.ps1 names a merged host by its era span and building ('Era 1-2. Paper Mills. Recipe BE 63%/47%') and titles every main group 'Base' ($pm_base$, as vanilla does), cosmetic; (4) tools/lint_pm_combos.mjs, run fatally by build.ps1: no legal method combination takes a good or a job below zero, no dead method, no 1836 block naming a method its building lacks, no incompatible pair carried, no labour-saving method on a craft rung. The 1836 history is semantically identical to the 2+1's build (whitespace only). ⚠ RELAUNCHED TWICE: the first launch (20261002_223204, built with a universal era rule the user then rejected) was stopped at 1876 in run 1, the second (20261002_232955, the reviewed table without the mandates) at its run 1 when the mandates were ruled — both VOID. Uncommitted at launch: the working tree's diff is saved in the session as CODE_DELTA.patch.
